user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search answers and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and policy compliance of ad landing pages.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: OpenAI generative AI foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and queries in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-requested web visits and GPT Actions, not automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Enhances generative AI model utility and safety by collecting public web materials.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: ClaudeBot Disallow: / to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content directed by Claude AI user queries.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to individual user prompts within Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: Claude-User Disallow: / to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes web content to enhance search response relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Navigates and indexes web content for search optimization and result quality.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: Claude-SearchBot Disallow: / to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes and crawl for Search, Discover, Images, Video, and News.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video-related content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform Search testing tools crawls such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search Console inspection tools; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for internal research and development by product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites; no specific product affected.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for non-product specific purposes.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for non-product specific purposes.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control use of crawled content for training Gemini models and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features and collects data for Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple generative AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines if crawled data is used to train generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Generative AI training for Apple Intelligence, Services, and Developer Tools.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content shared on Meta apps to display title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Meta-WebIndexer in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for advertising and business use cases.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Meta-ExternalAds in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for training foundation AI models or indexing directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Meta-ExternalAgent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links fetched at user request and websites navigated to complete tasks for users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Standard web crawler used for indexing content for Bing search and AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web pages and digital content across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews in search and services.
user_agents.scope: Web pages generating on-demand previews.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates rich previews and snapshots for Microsoft applications.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested for link previews in Microsoft apps.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow MicrosoftPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used to provide information to customers and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive and noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content eligible for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot or general search bots in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on user's behalf; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open dataset copies for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls publicly accessible web pages sampled from the Internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or request opt-out registry addition.
